Condition Index multivariate statistical approaches involve decomposing correlation matrix linear combinations variables. linear combinations chosen first combination largest possible variance (subject restrictions), second combination next largest variance, subject uncorrelated first, third largest possible variance, subject uncorrelated first second, forth. variance linear combinations called eigenvalue.
